Keisha (product): Quick thread to capture operator/playbook requirements for 'hedge credits' feature. Want a short, operational doc to hand to oncall + CS. Thoughts?
Ravi (eng): Key items: admission ordering, per-tenant soft caps, and deterministic preempt order. Keep preempt order FIFO per tenant to avoid starvation.
Omar (eng-runtime): Admission idea: reserved -> hedged -> shared. Hedged requests tagged with a credit-id so billing and idempotency are straightforward.
Priya (eng-sre): For runbook we need: symptoms (eg increased hedged preempts, p95 spike), immediate mitigations (disable hedged routing, reduce per-tenant cap, revert model fallback), and longer triage steps.
Nina (sales): Sales needs clear wording for pilots: what constitutes a hedged success vs preempted request, and how it'll appear on invoice.
Carlos (cs): CS wants a live UI widget showing remaining hedge credits + last 24h consumed, and an exportable CSV for billing disputes.
Keisha (product): Operator playbook draft bullets: 1) detection rules, 2) mitigation steps, 3) escalation path, 4) customer communication templates, 5) rollback plan. Add anything?
Ravi (eng): Add safety automation: if hedged preemption rate > 5% in 5m or hedged usage consumes > 20% of regional spare capacity for 10m, auto-disable hedged routing.
Omar (eng-runtime): Also include perf gates before enabling per-region: <0.5% error delta and <2% P95 regression after 1h canary.
Priya (eng-sre): Observability list: hedged_requests/sec, hedged_success_rate, preempt_events (with tenant id), hedged_credit_balance histogram, GPU util by host, tail latency by lane.
Keisha (product): For customer templates: short explanation + recommended actions (e.g., increase hedged credits, enable model fallbacks, bump reserved capacity) + apology + rollback timeline.
Nina (sales): Pricing note: pilot customers prefer prepaid monthly hedged bucket with rollover for unused credits. We should include billing metadata: credit_id, purchase_plan, applied_rate.
Carlos (cs): For disputes: include request-id, credit_id, timestamp, decision (accepted/preempted), and the admission-lane recorded in logs.
Ravi (eng): Implementation constraints: hedged_balance updates must be idempotent across retries — append an idempotency key to each decrement and keep short window dedupe. Use redis hash per-tenant sharded.
Omar (eng-runtime): Pseudocode for preempt (graceful): \n```\n# on reserved capacity reclaim\nmark_tenant_preempt(tenant)\nallow_inflight_to_finish(tenant, grace_window=3s)\nnew_requests_from_tenant -> route(shared_or_fail)\n```\nPriya (eng-sre): Rollout plan in playbook: internal smoke -> single-customer pilot in us-west -> 2-customer multi-region -> GA with Console toggle and alerting. Each gate requires metrics stability for 72h.
Keisha (product): Pilot acceptance criteria suggestion: hedged_success >= 80% during target spike, hedged P95 < 600ms, no more than 1 major oncall page attributable to hedged routing. Agree?
Nina (sales): Sounds reasonable; sales will negotiate pilot SLA but prefer to keep penalty-free beta.
Carlos (cs): Also require clear onboarding doc for pilots: how to opt-in, how to view credits, and how to escalate.
Ravi (eng): Security/abuse note: enforce per-tenant max hedged rate and circuit-breaker. Don't let a compromised key burn the pool.
Omar (eng-runtime): Test harness needed: burst generator that can simulate 10-100x normal qps with varying token lengths and headers to exercise preemption logic. Add 2 weeks for that.
Priya (eng-sre): Oncall runbook steps (concise): 1) check hedged success metric, 2) if systemic, disable hedged routing and notify CS + sales, 3) run per-tenant throttles or lift for specific tenants, 4) investigate host saturation.
Keisha (product): OK final asks for RFC: include operator playbook section, monitoring panels (list), billing schema for credit line-items, preemption semantics, and rollout gating. Can eng and SRE estimate effort?
Ravi (eng): Rough estimate: core runtime + idempotency ~4 sprint-weeks, billing + UI hooks ~2 sprint-weeks, observability + dashboards ~1 sprint-week, test harness ~2 sprint-weeks. Total ~9 sprint-weeks across teams.
Omar (eng-runtime): We'll break down into milestones in the RFC.
Nina (sales): I'll draft pilot customer outreach and contract wording for a non-penal beta.
Carlos (cs): I'll draft the onboarding checklist and dispute export format.
ops-bot: NOTE: feature-flag created: ff/hedge-credits -> off by default.
Keisha (product): Thanks — I'll assemble a one-pager and assign RFC owners. I'll ping for a quick sync tomorrow. :white_check_mark:
